<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/integrations/{id}/validate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Checks the connector credentials. For Chat2Desk it also looks the integration's webhook up in the customer's account: healthError is null when healthy, "invalid_credentials", "webhook_not_registered", "webhook_disabled" (Chat2Desk disables webhooks after delivery failures — Re-register re-enables it) or "webhook_check_failed" (Chat2Desk could not be queried; previous health kept).
